Package loveletter.model

Class Player

java.lang.Object
loveletter.model.Player
public class Player extends Object
Represents a player and stores their cards, affection tokens, elimination status and protection status.

Round-specific state is cleared by resetForNewRound(), while the player's name and affection tokens are preserved.

    • resetForNewRound

      public void resetForNewRound()
      Clears the hand and discard pile and resets elimination and protection status for a new round.

      The player's name and affection tokens are preserved. This method does not deal new cards.

    • swapHandWith

      public void swapHandWith(Player other)
      Exchanges the player's single hand card with another player's single hand card.

      Discard piles, affection tokens, elimination status and protection status remain unchanged.

      Parameters:
      other - the player to exchange hand cards with
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if other is null or refers to this player
      IllegalStateException - if either player does not hold exactly one card
